subject: english
question:
**Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.**

A doctor who specializes in heart diseases
solution: The correct answer is '**Cardiologist**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Cardiologist**'. • It means 'a doctor who specializes in treating heart diseases'. (दिल की बीमारियों का इलाज करनेवाला विशेषज्ञ; हृदयरोग विशेषज्ञ) • *Example: A consultant **cardiologist** who saw her that day said her heart problem needed to be dealt with fast.* **Correct Answer:__** *Cardiologist.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Urologist**: a doctor who specializes in the study or treatment of the function and disorders of the urinary system. (एक डॉक्टर जो मूत्र प्रणाली के कार्य और विकारों के अध्ययन या उपचार में माहिर हैं) • **Nephrologist**: medical professionals who diagnose, treat, and manage acute and chronic kidney problems and diseases. (किडनी रोग विशेषज्ञ) • **Dermatologist**: a doctor who studies and treats skin diseases. (चर्म-रोग चिकित्‍सक, त्‍वचा-विशेषज्ञ) f2:T911, The correct answer is 'I told you that he could not be trusted completely.'
